what_happened: A broad metadata-only rglob matched the common Angora ingest path prefix for every file rather than only candidate filenames; tool output was truncated and included unrelated historical order filenames including unshipped names.
remedy: No contents of those unrelated files were opened or used; do not count the truncated listing as a complete ingest. Restrict subsequent inventory to the social-intel directory and write its entire relevant filename list before selecting and reading any candidate.
impact: No change to historical files; no finance discrepancy or unshipped order content pursued. Does not satisfy complete-directory criterion for the accidentally broad exploratory listing.

what_happened: First boundary script expected a recommended URL substring to occur twice but it occurred six times in the stored page (image, title and date links repeated); assertion failed before inventory was written.
remedy: Reinspect occurrence count and take the first image-link occurrence; boundary is at 8000 text characters; generate offset/hash inventory without editing page transcription.
impact: Does not establish full manual transcription fidelity; failed assertion did not mutate the source file.

what_happened: Canonical URL chunk 0 reported 4 transcript chunks but subsequent chunks 1-3 reported 5 recommendation-page chunks; alias gave compatible transcript chunks 0-1 of 4 but chunks 2-3 returned a 6-chunk recommendation page.
remedy: Stopped after this one separately scoped alias; preserve the two complete returned transcript fragments as clearly partial and quarantined with a hash. Record incompatible recommendation calls as metadata only; do not splice them or use any incomplete video assertions.
impact: No full channel-video transcript or audio acquired. Some returned fragments contained unrelated commercial terms; not extracted as conclusions or follow-up. The metadata-only discarded recommendation blocks were not saved as full text and are not counted as complete source material.

what_happened: Three concurrent edits to the same newly created audit document reported success but two edits were overwritten; elapsed-time and source-whitespace notes were lost.
remedy: Reapply sequentially after rereading the file; verify the final audit and all local links and hashes. Disclosed to user.
impact: Affected new audit prose only; no historical source bytes or append prefixes changed.
